text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Terra
text: Luna is known; I need the hidden killer.

name: Luna
text: The officer may be anyone, so I should watch who pushes me.

name: Luna

name: Sol

name: Sol
text: Agreed. Let’s stay calm and see who pushes you.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Terra is gone. Terra's card stays face down.

text: The town turns on Haiku, and Haiku is out. Haiku shows the card: citizen.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the doctor, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the citizen, Sol the killer, Luna the killer, Terra the officer.

Haiku pushed Gemma hard on day one, and the town lynched her, but she was a citizen. Luna spent the next day shielding Sonnet and turning Haiku's pressure back on Haiku, while Sol eventually took back his own push against Luna. Terra was killed on night two before using any checks, and the officer's role died with them. On day two the town voted out Haiku, also a citizen, and the killers Sol and Luna won the game.
